summary: Iteration 5 tested end-to-end for hydration, photo gallery, favorites screen, outside meals + guide, and quick cards. Backend: 12/12 new iteration-5 tests + 58 regression = 70 pass / 1 skip in pytest (pytest_iter5.xml + pytest_all.xml). Hydration flow: GET /api/hydration/today returns {date=YYYY-MM-DD, glasses=0, goal=8, progress=0, history=[]}; POST /api/hydration {delta:3} → glasses=3, progress=38 ; {delta:-10} → floors to 0 (min); {delta:1, date:'bad'} → 400. PUT /api/hydration/goal {goal:10} → goal=10 (GET reflects), {goal:1} → 400, {goal:25} → 400. Photos gallery: GET /api/photos returns {photos:[], total:0} for fresh user; after multipart upload of a JPEG at week=0/day=0/meal=lunch, listing returns exactly one matching entry with path (starts with 'mon-plan-alimentaire/uploads/', ext '.jpg'), week=0, day=0, meal='lunch', meal_label='Déjeuner', recipe_name non-empty; after DELETE /meals/photo the same path disappears from /photos. Favorites: meals/action {action:'favorite'} on week 0 day 1 lunch → /favorites contains exactly one row with the correct recipe.name/week/day/meal; re-toggling clears meal.favorite AND removes the blueprint from preferences.favorites (row no longer favorite). Outside: meals/action {action:'outside'} on week 0 day 2 dinner → day.meals.dinner.outside=true AND done=true; re-toggle → outside=false (done may stay true). Regression: programs/current 200, badges 200 (6 badges), shopping/0 200 (checked+total). Frontend (390x844, testuser1@test.fr): (1) Accueil — hydration-card visible with hydration-count '2/8' initially, hydration-plus → '3/8' (persisted at '3/8' after a full page reload → confirms POST /api/hydration persistence), hydration-minus → back to '2/8', hydration-goal cycle → goal moved 8 → 10 (PUT /api/hydration/goal). All four quick cards visible: home-go-shopping, home-go-favorites, home-go-photos, home-go-inventory. (2) home-go-photos → /photos: title 'Mes photos de plats' visible, photos-group-* + photo-tile-0 rendered (existing data), photos-close returns to Accueil (hydration-card visible again). (3) home-go-favorites → /favorites: initially 0 rows, after opening /recipe?week=0&day=0&meal=lunch and clicking recipe-favorite (toast 'Retiré/Ajouté aux favoris'), /favorites shows fav-row-0 with 'Déjeuner · S1 Lundi Brochettes de saumon & semoule ⏱ 30 min · Un peu plus élaborée'; fav-cook-0 navigates to cooking mode and cooking-step-0 renders. Favori nettoyé après le test en re-toggle. (4) /recipe?week=0&day=0&meal=dinner: outside-toggle opens outside-guide containing '🍴 Le bon choix au restaurant', 🥩 Protéine, 🥦 Légumes, 🍚 Féculents lignes présentes; outside-mark → toggle text becomes 'Repas pris à l'extérieur ✓' (backend meal.outside=true, done=true); re-clicking outside-mark → 'Je mange à l'extérieur' (state reverted). (5) Console : 0 warning 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin', 0 pageerror, 0 console error pendant tout le parcours (login → hydration → photos → favoris → recette → outside).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:604-614 _hydration reads water_goal from preferences (default 8) and returns {date, glasses, goal, progress=round(glasses*100/goal), history=last 7}. Sane. progress capped at 100 — good.

server.py:622-630 POST /hydration validates YYYY-MM-DD strictly with regex and clamps glasses into [0..30] via max(0,min(30,...)) so the -10 floor is enforced server-side; hydration-minus in the UI still calls with delta -1 and the response overrides local optimistic state — no chance of drift.
server.py:633-638 PUT /hydration/goal enforces 2<=goal<=20 → 1 and 25 both correctly return 400; the response reuses _hydration() so goal is immediately reflected in GET /hydration/today.

server.py:641-651 GET /photos aggregates across ALL programs (not only active), tagging active flag and building a group label with program_name when inactive. Only meals with a .photo are included; DELETE /meals/photo clears meal.photo so the entry disappears from the gallery even though the raw db.photos row remains (acceptable — the row is scoped to user_id and only used by /files).

server.py:654-672 GET /favorites de-duplicates by (blueprint_id, name) so the same recipe repeated across days/weeks appears once; it includes rows where meal.favorite OR prefs.favorites contains the blueprint, which matches the UX intent (a favorite persists even after regeneration).
server.py:431-434 outside action toggles meal.outside AND sets meal.done=(outside OR previous done) — matches the spec exactly (re-toggle keeps done true). Message string is localized.
HydrationCard.tsx:38-40 optimistic update + server re-sync pattern is clean; busy guard prevents double-taps; the goal cycle 8→10→12→6 wraps at >=12 which matches the informal spec of stepping by 2.
photos.tsx:80 Pressable.disabled when p.program_id !== program.id is a nice guard so users cannot navigate to a recipe screen of an inactive/deleted program.

favorites.tsx:67-77 fav-row-i and fav-cook-i testIDs use the array index directly, which matches the request; the row itself opens the recipe, the inner Pressable opens cooking mode — no overlap because inner Pressable stops propagation via its own onPress.

success_rate.backend: 100% (70 passed, 1 skipped in the whole /app/backend/tests suite). Iteration 5 subset: 12/12 green — hydration GET/POST/PUT (defaults, +3, floor at 0, bad date 400, goal 10 ok, goal 1 & 25 → 400), photos upload → list → delete cycle (path/week/day/meal/meal_label='Déjeuner'/recipe_name all correct), favorites toggle + re-toggle removes blueprint from prefs.favorites, outside toggle (outside=true+done=true then outside=false), regression current/badges/shopping.
success_rate.frontend: 100% for tested flows on 390x844 web preview: hydration +1/persistence after reload/-1/goal cycle 8→10; four quick cards visible and tappable; /photos title + group + tile + close; /favorites empty→add via recipe-favorite→row with recipe name→fav-cook-0 opens cooking-step-0; recipe outside-toggle expands guide with 🥩🥦🍚 lines & 'restaurant' keyword, outside-mark toggles and reverts the button label. Zero JS pageerrors, zero 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin' warning in console.

seed_data_creation: Iteration-5 backend tests self-sign-up disposable users (test_it5_<uuid>@test.fr) — fully isolated. Frontend test on testuser1@test.fr left goal at 10 verres and glasses at 2 for today (was 2 before); the test toggled favorite on week0/day0 lunch and then re-toggled it off (state reset); outside on week0/day0 dinner was toggled twice (net effect: outside=false, done may remain true depending on prior state). No orphan test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 endpoints: GET /api/hydration/today, POST /api/hydration {delta:int, date?:YYYY-MM-DD}, PUT /api/hydration/goal {goal:2..20}, GET /api/photos {photos:[{path, program_id, program_name, active, week, day, day_name, meal, meal_label, recipe_name}], total}, GET /api/favorites {favorites:[{program_id, week, day, day_name, meal, meal_label, recipe, components, photo, favorite, done}], total}, POST /api/programs/{pid}/meals/action {action:'outside', week, day, meal} → toggles meal.outside and forces done=true when going true. Frontend testIDs (iter5): hydration-card, hydration-count, hydration-plus, hydration-minus, hydration-goal (Accueil); home-go-shopping, home-go-favorites, home-go-photos, home-go-inventory (Accueil quick cards); photos-close, photos-group-<key>, photo-tile-<i> (/photos); favorites-close, fav-row-<i>, fav-cook-<i> (/favorites); outside-toggle, outside-guide, outside-mark (/recipe). Note: the goal cycle in HydrationCard.tsx wraps 8→10→12→6 (>=12 resets to 6). photos.tsx Pressable is disabled for tiles that belong to a non-active program. favorites.tsx dedupes by (blueprint_id, recipe.name). Backend meal_label uses engine.MEAL_LABELS (breakfast='Petit-déjeuner', lunch='Déjeuner', snack='Collation', dinner='Dîner'). Object storage init is best-effort — if the env has no key the endpoint returns 402 and the test skips gracefully (I confirmed uploads work in this env).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bug detected in iteration 5 features. All 12 new backend tests passed on the first run, all frontend flows passed on the first run, and the previously reported 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin' warning is no longer present in the console (grep for 'transform-origin' in /app/frontend also returns nothing — the SVG stroke rotation was probably reworked to use rotate() attribute in HydrationCard.tsx:59).
